name: controls-timeline
title: Controls Timeline
author: George Drury <info@georgedrury.co.uk>
description: Animation clips defined in code with useControlsTimeline, tuned in a timeline editor: scrub, move and resize clips, and edit their values. Built on DialKit's headless timeline.

meta.example:
const timeline = useControlsTimeline("Card", { enter: { at: 0, duration: 0.6, from: { y: 24 }, to: { y: 0 } } })
<ControlsTimeline />
